name: Technical design pages
explanation: Technical design is a small tree of pages. A landing page names three areas and what each holds; the ERD, Systems and Components areas are pages of their own at /technical/erd, /technical/systems and /technical/components, each built only when read. Every definition keeps one canonical page per exact revision at /technical/{kind}/{id}: the unique current one, or a saved pin with its stale, retired or conflicted status and no repinning. Competing heads are named without choosing one.

code.note: Names the three areas, their paths and the definition kinds beneath each, so pages, breadcrumbs and the sidebar place a definition in the same area.
The landing page counts each area's records and says how to start an empty one; nothing resolves.
Builds only the requested area's directory with explicit intent, lifecycle, revision heads, code and Item-use counts, and comparison newness only when comparing.
Resolves the requested or unique current revision exactly, lists competing heads, and reports the shown pin's status without substituting another revision.
